我的生活与购物(My Life and shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的A2短文:凯特与利奥的经历和小计划。
Last Friday, Kate and Leo went to the discount area. The weather was windy that day. Kate learned a lot about history. Best of all, these clothes are new.
There are always many people at the cashier. Kate wrote about the day in the diary. Kate bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. The salad is fresh and crunchy.
The discount area is one of the best places in the city. Kate usually has fish for breakfast. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, salad boxes go half price at six.
They took many photos at the cashier. Kate is reading a book about history. Both of them like fish and coffee.
